summary: create/edit send the API's canonical 'created' field instead of 'date' (flag stays --date).
reason: Expensify ignores 'date' on /RequestMoney and /EditMoneyRequest, so every expense landed as today; 'created' is what the API reads back.
validated_outcome: Live create with --date 2025-11-17 read back created=2025-11-17.
